description: Verification report after presentation authorization remediation implementation

remediatedDefects.resolution: Enforced PresentationDecision::Suggestion for chapter-only/fuzzy references and bounded PresentationDecision::Reject/Suggestion for conversational noise.

remediatedDefects.defect: positional results[index] indexing in live session
remediatedDefects.resolution: Refactored authorize_emitted_results to match candidates by canonical coordinates (book, chapter, verse) instead of positional index.
Populated quote_coverage from actual lexical word overlap score and passed verified candidate margin into evidence carriers.
Added atomic auto_mode and live_output_enabled fields to AppState, synchronized via update_detection_settings, and routed through is_automation_live_enabled(app).

remediatedDefects.defect: global static EvidenceLedger without STT session scoping
remediatedDefects.resolution: Added reset_evidence_ledger() and invoked on start_transcription and stop_transcription lifecycles.

remediatedDefects.defect: frontend test suite mixed legacy and new authorization contracts
remediatedDefects.resolution: Updated frontend workflow to purely consume backend presentation grants and aligned test suites with typed authorization model.
